legend: You are on vacation in a foreign country. This country has a local football league, and you don't know any of the team names. However, you have found a table of all the results from this season, and next to every match is the concatenated names of the two teams that played.

There are n$$$n$$$ teams in total, named s1,s2,⋯,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \cdots, s_n$$$. You are given the concatenation si+sj$$$s_i+s_j$$$ for every ordered pair i≠j$$$i \neq j$$$. Find the teams names s1,s2,⋯,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \cdots, s_n$$$. Team names must be nonempty, but they do not need to be distinct.
input: The first line of input contains the integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤500$$$2 \leq n \leq 500$$$).

The following n$$$n$$$ lines each contain n$$$n$$$ strings, the table of concatenated team names. The j$$$j$$$:th string on the i$$$i$$$:th of these lines will contain the string si+sj$$$s_i + s_j$$$ if i≠j$$$i \neq j$$$, and "*" if i=j$$$i = j$$$. The concatenated team names will consist of lower case characters a-z.
The total number of characters in concatenated team names is at most 106$$$10^6$$$.
output: If there is no solution, print "NONE".
If there is more than one solution, print "MANY".
If there is one unique solution, print "UNIQUE", followed by n$$$n$$$ lines containing s1,s2,⋯,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \cdots, s_n$$$.

examples.input:
3
* difaik difhammarby
aikdif * aikhammarby
hammarbydif hammarbyaik *

3
* a ab
a * b
ba b *

legend.ai: 你正在一个外国度假。这个国家有一个当地的足球联赛，而你不知道任何球队的名称。不过，你找到了本赛季所有比赛结果的表格，并且每场比赛旁边都写着参赛两支球队名称的拼接结果。
总共有 n$$$n$$$ 支球队，名称为 s1,s2,⋯,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \cdots, s_n$$$。对于每个有序对 i≠j$$$i \neq j$$$，给定拼接字符串 si+sj$$$s_i+s_j$$$。请找出球队名称 s1,s2,⋯,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \cdots, s_n$$$。球队名称必须非空，但不必互不相同。

input.ai: 输入第一行包含整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤500$$$2 \leq n \leq 500$$$)。
接下来 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个字符串，表示球队名称拼接结果表。第 i$$$i$$$ 行中的第 j$$$j$$$ 个字符串在 i≠j$$$i \neq j$$$ 时为 si+sj$$$s_i + s_j$$$，在 i=j$$$i = j$$$ 时为 "*"。拼接后的球队名称仅由小写字母 a-z 组成。
拼接后的球队名称中字符总数最多为 106$$$10^6$$$。

output.ai: 如果存在唯一解，输出 "UNIQUE"，随后输出 n$$$n$$$ 行，其中包含 s1,s2,⋯,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \cdots, s_n$$$。
